question: Anthurium, named after a famous flower, is a major festival of which of the following states?
solution: The correct answer is __**Mizoram**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Named after a famous flower, Anthurium is a major festival in** Mizoram**. • Anthurium is celebrated with an objective of** promoting tourism **and it is held in the month of September each year. • A small village called** Reiek** (about 70kms from capital city Aizawl) is the venue for this fest. • Folk dance, music and cuisine are the highlight of this festival.
